headline: CytomX Therapeutics Announces Q2 2026 Financial Results and Provides Business Update
summary: Varsetatug masetecan (“Varseta-M”) Program: - Phase 1 monotherapy update in advanced colorectal cancer (CRC) expected by the end of 2026. Registrational study planned for initiation in 1H 2027 - - Phase 1 study in combination with bevacizumab in 3L+ mCRC ongoing. Phase 1/2 chemotherapy combination study focused in 2L mCRC initiating in Q4 2026 - - Phase 1 monotherapy expansion cohorts initiating in Q3 2026 in gastric and gastroesophageal junction (GEJ), EpCAM-selected pancreatic ductal adenocarc
